Tuesday: 10:30-11:00, 13:00-14:00 (13:00-13:30 or 13:30-14:00), 16:30-17:00
Wednesday: 15:00-15:30, 16:00-16:30
Thursday: 9:00-9:30, 16:30-17:00
Friday: 11:00-11:30, 11:30-12:00 (11:00-12:00), 13:00-13:30, 14:30-15:00, 16:30-17:00

Please read Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and tell me which of these slots work for them too. My top recommendations would be Tuesday 13:00-13:30 or Friday 11:00-11:30.
